environment.storage: In-memory range provider with warm native metadata cache

design: Gather at most 128 references in source document order, validate selected rows, then gather bounded identity spans in source offset order and emit in requested output order.
Reject sparse metadata/ID span expansion beyond four source rows/bytes per selected row/byte. Skip sorting already ordered references.

Validate the batch once, then gather bounded output-order windows without replaying metadata reads. Shrink windows before I/O when sparse span expansion exceeds the gather cap; stream oversized individual native IDs separately. Heap IDs borrow their reader and share packed output writes with native IDs.
Keep contiguous output writes; buffer fragmented small IDs into fixed 8 KiB writes. Returned values never borrow this gather scope.
Seal stored-metadata append CRC tracking before body writes; intersect patches with the sealed range and reread only dirty checksum pages. Plain sinks retain the existing range-CRC contract.
Use deletion rank for live-input checks with and without a prepared frozen index.

Traverse borrowed live ranges by cached Roaring container and bitmap word, with forward seeking after intact block copies. Reuse the traversal in stored-field passes and sort plans; derive streaming sort live counts from rank.
Record append provenance in live spans, retaining the dense fallback for fragmented mappings; traverse live ranges during external sorting.

Prepare ordinal section descriptors once and gather up to 128 references in source order using a fixed 512-byte read buffer. Preserve requested order, duplicates, missing ordinals and all-zero section omission.

Skip fully deleted typed-value inputs and keep complement traversal across chunks; seek within validated ordered doc IDs before constructing surviving values. Indexed streams expose authenticated per-chunk bounds and relative-ID bases; fully excluded chunks skip decoding and intact chunks copy compressed bytes with a shifted external base. Legacy streams retain bounded decoding.
Binary-search array-container seeks and contiguous deletion-run boundaries using monotonic value-minus-index deltas.
coverage: Dense, sparse-deleted and reversed IDs against individual reads; mixed input numbering and duplicate references.
Empty IDs, mixed heap/native formats, oversized individual IDs and batches exceeding the gather cap.
Injected cold ID read failure and invalid selected metadata row before gathered IDs are emitted; retry after failure.
Sealed CRC ranges with unaligned tails, body-only patches and patches crossing the metadata boundary.
Empty inputs and fully/partially deleted liveness with frozen and bitmap-only navigation.
File-backed sort plans fill each 128-document gather with reads of at most 64 records; in-memory plans copy their borrowed slices into the gather buffer.
Long dense and reversed identities across the gather cap; mixed readers retain native gathering and packed writes.
Sparse/dense/missing Roaring containers, uint32 end boundary, forward seeks and randomized complement traversal; end-to-end merge with one surviving document.
Ordinal gathers with shuffled, duplicate, sparse, mixed heap/native and absent references; sorted output and all-zero omission.
Fixed and variable-width typed-value exclusion cursors across chunks against unfiltered output; provenance range mappings across fragmentation and output boundaries.
limitations: Cache probes count cache navigation/locking, not disk operations. Native Debug production-helper fixtures do not establish end-to-end throughput or 2 GiB soak behavior. Shuffled ID gathering adds bounded ordering/copy work; short live spans may read deleted gap bytes within the fourfold bound. Output/page checksum bookkeeping remains proportional to artifact page count. Indexed typed navigation uses 32 bytes per chunk instead of 8; copying avoids codec work but still reads and writes compressed bytes. Existing binaries do not understand the new flagged typed format.

sparse_survivor_navigation.measurement: Review-only isDeleted instrumentation; all three stored-field production passes.

array_deleted_run_navigation.measurement: Review-only instrumentation of production AbsentRangeIterator; warm in-memory bitmap. These counts describe different operations, not a throughput ratio.

ordinal_gather.measurement: Native Debug production helpers: scalar SegmentReader.docOrdinal versus gatherOrdinals, with warm metadata cache. Descriptor preparation is excluded from both value-read counts.

typed_sparse_exclusion.before_format: Legacy front directory, 128 rows per chunk
typed_sparse_exclusion.after_format: Indexed stream, 64 KiB raw chunk target
typed_sparse_exclusion.measurement: Native Debug Cursor fixture; operation counts, not throughput. Chunk counts differ because byte-bounded streaming encoding splits large values.

typed_intact_merge.measurement: Native Debug production append helper with a non-allocating sink; each build generates its own source format. Indexed source chunks copy compressed bytes; historical sources retain decoding. Fixed stack buffers and output ownership are excluded from heap scratch.

typed_partial_prefix_copy.measurement: Native Debug append and sorted production helpers; compressed bytes verified equal to their source after document-ID remapping.
